- Cook once (Sun/Mon): chicken in air-fryer/oven, rice in rice cooker, veg in steamer → several meals.
- Recombine: chicken + rice + veg / wrap / salad / potatoes / bowl.

- Breakfast (5 min): 2–3 eggs, toast, fruit, coffee/tea
- Lunch (5 min): chicken, rice, veg, yogurt/lemon sauce
- Snack: Greek yogurt, fruit
- Dinner (15–20 min): fish/chicken, potatoes, veg

One shop every 5–7 days (Lulu downstairs).

Protein: 1–1.5 kg chicken, 4–6 fish portions, 18 eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, tuna, chickpeas/beans, lean beef (small).

Fruit: bananas, apples, oranges, berries (whatever's cheap).

- 5 min warm-up/mobility

- Work: 2 × 60–90 min focused blocks
- Food: protein each meal, fruit/veg, mostly water
- Movement: 20–40 min walk or workout
- Life: stop at reasonable time
